title: Proposed Bonifacio museum, Kartilya display bills tackled in Senate
summary: The Senate Committee on Culture and the Arts held a committee hearing on the proposed Andres Bonifacio Museum Act and the Kartilya ng Katipunan Act, to honor the father of Philippine Revolution.
